messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for service `frontend-inference`
deploy-bot: env=prod-us-west, commit=a1b2c3d4, tag=v2.7.1-canary, started_by=@lina, initial_traffic=2%, ramp_plan=2->10% over 30m

lina: kicking this off — change window until 22:00 PT. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-15/v2.7.1

devon: watching p50/p95 + error-rate dashboards. i'll post smoke checks in ~10m

deploy-bot: smoke tests: step 1 (health checks) PASSED, step 2 (end-to-end synth) PASSED
deploy-bot: current traffic=2%, avg latency p95=128ms, error_rate=0.02%

maya: seeing a tiny spike at t+5m — 0.12% errors for ~30s on replica r3. investigating logs now @devon

carlos: pinning model_version in rollout config to `model-2026-03-14-5692` to avoid model rotation during canary. config update applied:
```
rollout:
  model_version: "model-2026-03-14-5692"
  traffic: 2
  autoscale: true
```

jen: FYI product asked us to hold if UX tokenization changes surface. do we have tests for that?

devon: checked tokenizer smoke set — baseline tokens match for 95/100 samples. one mismatch in emoji handling; not user-facing likely.

maya: error spike traced to transient OOM on r3; ops bumped queue limits and restarted the pod. metrics back to baseline (0.03%). recommending continue ramp but keep close watch.

lina: thumbs — promote to 10% now if everyone ok. calling for a 10m watch period then re-evaluate for 50%

deploy-bot: promoting canary -> traffic=10% (rolling update across 4 AZs). commit=a1b2c3d4, tag=v2.7.1-canary

devon: observing: p95 stable, CPU on r2 increased but within buffer, no new errors.

maya: running regression suite for tokenization subset — all green so far.

carlos: noted: pinned version prevents hot-rotate, remember to unpin once fully promoted

lina: decision for 50% in 15m unless regressions. post final call here. :eyes:

deploy-bot: 15m check -> traffic=10%, p95=134ms, error_rate=0.03%, synth_tests=PASS

lina: promote to 50% and schedule full rollout at 30m if stable.

deploy-bot: promoting to 50% — will ramp to 100% in incremental steps after hold window.

maya: quick note — add a postmortem alert rule for OOM spikes to catch r3 earlier next time. filing ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-4123

jen: product confirms look good on our sample users. go for full once stable. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: ramping to 100% steady-state over next 10m. finalizing release metadata.

deploy-bot: Deployment finished: service=frontend-inference, env=prod-us-west, final_tag=v2.7.1, commit=a1b2c3d4, duration=34m, promoted_by=@lina

devon: leaving a note to rollback-to v2.7.0 if any major regressions appear in the next 2h window.

lina: added release note blurb and changelog. thanks all — will unpin model_version after 24h if no issues.

jen: adding customer-facing announcement to the release schedule.

deploy-bot: logs & artifacts: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/deploys/1961234567, changelist: https://github.com/redwood/repo/compare/a1b2c3d4

lina: thread closed unless someone sees an escalation. :wave:
